text: Understanding databases is important for anyone interested in technology. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store information in tables, which look like spreadsheets with rows and columns. To get data from them, you write queries using a special language. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data differently. Data modeling helps you plan how information is organised before you build anything. Finally, indexes make searches much faster, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database and designing it well can save time and make your applications work better.
